title: USB Audio Out (track 8)
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack as a stereo USB audio input (UAC2, 44.1 kHz, 24-bit) on its own USB port, as a function of usb-ot: track 8 post-FX before its level (the master track's output with MASTER TRACK on), at both speeds. It combines with USB MIDI. One of mods/usb-audio-ot's five layouts.
